title: CounterIncrementRequest
description: Atomic counter change request. Written by Autopilot/Archive/Memory; processed by the counter service to prevent race conditions.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this increment request (UUID)

delta.description: Signed increment value. Positive to increment, negative to decrement.

source_module.description: Module name issuing the request (autopilot | archive | memory)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when request was created

idempotency_key.description: Optional key for exactly-once delivery. If provided, duplicate requests with the same key are ignored.

precondition.description: Optional conditional check before applying delta

min_value.description: Request is rejected if current value < min_value (prevents negative counters)

max_value.description: Request is rejected if current value > max_value (prevents runaway counters)

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the increment (logged but not enforced)
